module: Simple pneumatic suspension/cylinder auxiliary controller (type "auxiliary"): it drives the pressure of "pressurized" beams (obj:setBeamPressureRel) grouped into named groups, with named pressure levels (minPressure, maxPressure, defaultPressure...), rise/fall speeds and inflation/deflation sounds. Unlike pneumatics/actuators, no gas physics or tank is modeled: the pressure simply follows the target at a limited speed. The public functions are called from inputs or other controllers with a list of group names.
usage:
local p = controller.getControllerSafe('pneumatics')
p.setBeamMax({"suspension"})        -- inflate to the maximum
p.setBeamPressure({"suspension"}, 30) -- 30 PSI raw
notes: Units: the pressures in the jbeam and in the functions are in PSI; the conversion to pascals (1 PSI = 6894.757 Pa) is done internally for obj:setBeamPressureRel.

Controller jbeam keys: pressuredBeams (name of the v.data table listing the beams; each entry contains beamName, groupName and possibly fields ending in "Pressure" (own levels), increaseRate, decreaseRate), pressureLevels (header table name/pressure for common levels; minPressure and maxPressure are 0 by default), increaseRate (0), decreaseRate (0) in PSI/s, groupSounds (v.data table name for the sounds: groupName, node, volumeUp, volumeDown, soundUp, soundDown, stopVelocityThresholdPressureIncrease, stopVelocityThresholdPressureDecrease).
Beam fields read from the beam itself: name, pressurePSI (default pressure), maxPressure, beamSpring, beamDamp.
If an increaseRate/decreaseRate is 0, the pressure does not move.

The sounds stop either when the pressure has reached its target, or when the beams' average speed falls back below a threshold (if defined). The sound calls fail if a group has no sounds defined (soundLoopUp/soundLoopDown nil), inferred from code.

init.desc: Builds the beam groups from the jbeam tables and the pressure levels.

initSounds.desc: Creates the rise/fall sound sources of each group. Called by the controller manager.

reset.desc: Returns all beams to their default pressure.

resetSounds.desc: Cuts the sound volume and resets their state.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: applies the momentary increases/decreases, advances the current pressure toward the target at a limited speed and handles stopping the sounds.

setBeamMin.desc: Targets the minimum pressure (minPressure) of the groups.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamMax.desc: Targets the maximum pressure (maxPressure) of the groups.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamDefault.desc: Targets the default pressure (defaultPressure) of the groups.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamPressure.desc: Directly sets the target pressure of the groups, bounded by the min and max of each beam.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamPressureLevel.desc: Targets a named pressure level (beam key, e.g. "maxPressure" or a level defined in pressureLevels).

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

toggleBeamMinMax.desc: For each group: switches to the minimum if everything is at the maximum, otherwise to the maximum.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamMomentaryIncrease.desc: Enables/disables the continuous pressure increase of the groups (as long as enabled is true); disables the decrease.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

setBeamMomentaryDecrease.desc: Enables/disables the continuous pressure decrease of the groups; disables the increase.

groupNames.desc: Beam group names (groupName of the pressurized beams table).

isBeamGroupAtPressureLevel.desc: Indicates whether all beams of a group are exactly at the named pressure level.

returns.desc: True if the group is at this level; also false if the group does not exist.
